newsitem.title: USA: American Airlines to match Delta winter sale.
newsitem.headline: American Airlines to match Delta winter sale.

text.p: FORT WORTH, TEX., Dec 30 (Reuter) AMR Corp's American Airlines unit said it will match a winter fare sale set by Delta Air Lines Monday in all competitive markets.
All sale conditions will be the same as Delta's, an American Airlines spokesman said.
Delta's winter fare sale features discounts of up to 40 percent on flights throughout North America, Europe, Asia and the Caribbean.
